all.src: Directional gate: last close > 20-EMA AND 20-EMA > 50-SMA, or a breakout above the prior 20-day high on >1.5x average volume.
IV rank <= 40 (this is a long-vol/long-premium structure).
DTE between 25 and 50 for swing entries.
Long strike delta between 0.40 and 0.70; short strike delta between 0.15 and 0.35.
Long strike delta between 0.40 and 0.70; short strike delta between 0.15 and 0.35.
Both legs: open interest >= 500 and bid/ask spread <= 10% of the leg mid, or <= $0.05 absolute.

management.src: Take profit: close the whole spread at 65% of max profit (i.e., spread mid >= net debit + 0.65 * (width - debit)).
Stop loss: close if spread mid <= 50% of net debit paid, or if the underlying closes below the 20-EMA that triggered entry -- whichever comes first.
Time stop: if at 10 DTE the spread mid is below the entry debit, close it. Long verticals bleed fastest in the last two weeks.

exits.src: Hard rule: close the entire spread no later than 15:45 ET on expiration day regardless of P/L. Never let a leg expire.
ASSIGNMENT GUARD: if the short call is in the money by any amount at 15:30 ET on expiration day, close the full spread immediately at market-plus-limit (limit = bid - $0.05, repriced every 15s).
DIVIDEND GUARD: if the short call is ITM and its extrinsic value < 1.5 * the upcoming dividend, close the spread no later than the close of the session before the ex-dividend date.
DIVIDEND GUARD: if the short call is ITM and its extrinsic value < 1.5 * the upcoming dividend, close the spread no later than the close of the session before the ex-dividend date.
